title: SMD circular dated August 21,1996
text: Home »Legal»Circulars SMD circular dated August 21,1996 Aug 21, 1996| Circulars SECONDARY MARKET DEPARTMENT August 21, 1996 To, The Executive Director/President/ Managing Director of all Stock Exchanges. Dear Sir, Please refer to our Fax message dated August 20, 1996. You are further requested to furnish us the information in the following format for the period from April 1995 to August 20, 1996. Name of Date of Board Meeting Board Meeting SEBI Appointment held during the attended by Nominee of SEBI tenure of SEBI SEBI Nominee Nominee Nominee Please arrange to send above mentioned information within two days. Thanking you, Yours faithfully, sd/- R. Krishnanand Officer
